title: Cyber Witch Digital Ritual
description: A vibrant pink-haired woman in a pink belly dancer outfit sits on the floor of a cluttered, dimly lit bedroom, holding a smartphone up to capture a selfie with her own glowing pink reflection in an ornate full-length mirror. The mirror reflects her posing seductively with multiple arms, while the surrounding room is filled with computer monitors displaying code and a swirling pink vortex, energy drink cans, notebooks, and scattered clothing.
prompt: A young woman with bright pink hair in a ponytail sits on the floor of a messy dark bedroom, wearing a revealing pink belly dancing outfit with gold details. She holds up a smartphone to take a mirror selfie. The large ornate mirror in front of her shows a glowing pink reflection of her posing with multiple arms. The room contains a desk with multiple computer monitors showing green code and a swirling pink vortex, energy drink cans, notebooks, a gaming chair with a blue jacket, scattered clothes and cables, and a bed with pillows. Moody lighting with strong pink and blue tones, highly detailed digital painting.
